purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA JMA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt (claims) software. It handles comment editing/auto-recording for medical receipts, processing multiple indexed receipt data files (RECE02, RECE04, RECE05 and their work/output variants) and writing error records. The program has been extensively maintained over many years to support Japanese national health insurance billing rule changes.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance receipt processing)

verdict.notes: The file is decoded with latin-1 but the Japanese comments are likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoded, causing garbled display. The COPY REPLACING with // delimiters is characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL. The program is clearly production-grade medical billing software from the open-source ORCA project maintained by the Japan Medical Association. The truncation at 16000 chars covers only the header and early DATA DIVISION; the bulk of the PROCEDURE DIVISION is not shown but the structural indicators (1083 PERFORMs, 53 CALLs, 540 PICs) confirm a large, complex production program.
